* Utility methods for dealing with arrays of ByteBuffers.
 *
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public static void checkNotNull(ByteBuffer[] buffers)
methods.comment: * Throws {@link IllegalArgumentException} if any of the buffers in the array are null.

methods.name: public static long remaining(ByteBuffer[] buffers)
methods.comment: * Returns the total number of bytes remaining in the buffer array.

methods.name: public static void consume(ByteBuffer[] sourceBuffers, int toConsume)
methods.comment:
* Marks {@code toConsume} bytes of data as consumed from the buffer array.
     *
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if there are fewer than {@code toConsume} bytes remaining

methods.name: public static ByteBuffer getBufferLargerThan(ByteBuffer[] buffers, int minSize)
methods.comment:
* Looks for a buffer in the buffer array which EITHER is larger than {@code minSize} AND
     * has no preceding non-empty buffers OR is the only non-empty buffer in the array.

methods.name: public static ByteBuffer copyNoConsume(ByteBuffer[] buffers, ByteBuffer destination, int maxAmount)
methods.comment: * Copies up to {@code maxAmount} bytes from a buffer array to {@code destination}. * The copied data is not marked as consumed from the source buffers, on the * assumption the copy will be passed to some method which will consume between 0 and * {@code maxAmount} bytes which can then be reflected in the source array using the * {@code consume()} method. *

methodNames: public static void consume(ByteBuffer[] sourceBuffers, int toConsume)
public static ByteBuffer getBufferLargerThan(ByteBuffer[] buffers, int minSize)
public static ByteBuffer copyNoConsume(ByteBuffer[] buffers, ByteBuffer destination, int maxAmount)
